annotations.title: Find companies and new registrations in official registers

description: Official company registers in one schema. mode "new": companies newly registered in France (BODACC), Norway (Brønnøysund), Finland (PRH), Estonia and the US states New York, Colorado, Connecticut and Oregon, and in France also insolvency judgments, deregistrations and business sales; filter by NACE/NAF industry code, city/region/postcode and keywords. mode "search": companies by name in France (with officers), Norway, Finland, Estonia, Czechia, the four US states and, for other countries, the worldwide LEI index. Registry id, legal form, status, dates, industry, address, employees, capital, officers or registered agents, business email where published (Connecticut), register link. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/company-registry on your Apify account (about $0.0025 per company; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

countries.description: ISO codes: FR, NO, FI, EE, CZ; US (all four states) or one state: US-NY, US-CO, US-CT, US-OR; others are searched in the LEI index.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

industry_codes.description: NACE/NAF code prefixes, e.g. ["56.10"] restaurants, ["62"] IT; NAICS for Connecticut.

locations.description: Cities, regions or postcode prefixes, e.g. ["Oslo", "75"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

mode.description: new = registrations and register events; search = look up by name.

name: find_companies

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
